question: How do I reset my student account password?
answer: Go to the LPU self-service portal at password.LPU.example and click 'Forgot password'. Verify your identity with your student ID and the code sent to your registered mobile number. If you cannot receive the code, visit the IT Service Desk in the Main Library with a photo ID.

question: How do I connect to the campus Wi-Fi?
answer: Select the 'LPU-Secure' network and log in with your student email and password. Guests should use 'LPU-Guest', which requires registration and is limited to 24 hours. Do not use the older 'NU-Wifi' network, as it was retired in 2024.

question: How do I set up my student email?
answer: Your email address is your student ID followed by @students.LPU.example. Sign in at mail.LPU.example with your university password. Multi-factor authentication must be enabled within 7 days of your first login.

question: How do I register for courses?
answer: Log in to the Student Portal and open 'Course Registration'. Registration opens on April 1 for the Fall semester and November 1 for the Spring semester. You must clear any registration holds, such as unpaid fees, before you can enrol.

question: What is the deadline to add or drop a course?
answer: You can add or drop courses without penalty until the end of the second week of the semester. Dropping between weeks 3 and 8 results in a 'W' (withdrawal) on your transcript. After week 8, dropping a course is not permitted except for approved medical or emergency reasons.

question: How do I request an official transcript?
answer: Request transcripts through the Registrar's page in the Student Portal. Electronic transcripts cost $5 and are delivered within 1 business day. Printed transcripts cost $10 and take 3 to 5 business days to be mailed.

question: When is tuition due and how can I pay?
answer: Tuition is due by August 15 for the Fall semester and January 10 for the Spring semester. You can pay online by credit or debit card, by bank transfer, or in person at the Bursar's Office. A late fee of $50 applies after the due date.

question: Can I pay my tuition in installments?
answer: Yes. The Instalment Plan lets you split tuition into 4 equal payments each semester. There is a one-time enrolment fee of $25. Sign up through the 'Payments' section of the Student Portal before the tuition due date.

question: How do I apply for financial aid or a scholarship?
answer: Submit the Financial Aid Application through the Student Portal by March 1 for the following academic year. You will need your family income documents and your latest transcript. Results are emailed within 4 weeks of submission.

question: What are the library opening hours?
answer: The Main Library is open Monday to Friday from 8:00 AM to 10:00 PM and Saturday and Sunday from 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM. During final exam weeks it is open 24 hours a day. Hours may be reduced during public holidays.

question: How many books can I borrow and for how long?
answer: Undergraduate students can borrow up to 10 books for 21 days, and postgraduate students up to 20 books for 28 days. Loans can be renewed twice online unless another student has requested the item. Overdue books cost $0.50 per day.

question: How do I get or replace my student ID card?
answer: New students collect their ID card at the Student Services Centre with a government-issued photo ID. Replacing a lost card costs $15 and takes 1 business day. Report a lost card immediately so it can be deactivated.

question: How do I book a study room?
answer: Book study rooms through the Library app or website using your student login. Bookings are limited to 2 hours per day and can be made up to 7 days in advance. Rooms are released if nobody checks in within 15 minutes.

question: What mental health and counselling support is available?
answer: The Counselling Centre in Wellbeing House offers free, confidential sessions to all enrolled students. Book an appointment through the Student Portal or by calling 555-0142. A 24/7 crisis line is available at 555-0199.

question: How do I contact the Student Helpdesk?
answer: Email helpdesk@LPU.example or call 555-0100. The helpdesk is open Monday to Friday from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM. You can also visit the Student Services Centre, Room 101, without an appointment.
